guidebook.intro: Yogera ku bizinensi yo: abaguzi, amagoba, okutereka n’ebanja.

tips.title: “How is business?”
body: Okubuuza ku bizinensi: **How is business?** Okudamu: **Business is good.** oba **Good. Today there are many customers.**

tips.title: “I don’t have any”
body: Mu sentensi egaana kozesa **any**: **I don’t have any debt.** **We don’t have any sugar.** Mu sentensi ekiriza kozesa **some** oba **a lot of**: **I have made a lot of profit.**

tips.title: Okukozesa omuntu
body: Mu Lusoga ekikolwa kikyuka: **nsoma → nsomesa**, **ndya → ndisa**, **nywa → nywesa**. Mu Lungereza bitera okuba ebikolwa ebirala: **I teach**, **I feed**, oba **I give … a drink**: **I give the cows water.**
table: I drink → I give a drink to

culture.title: Ebibiina by’okutereka
body: Abantu bangi batereka sente mu bibiina. Mu Lungereza: **a savings group** oba **a Saco**. **I save money with my group every week.**
